author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Rebuilt the PDF header (Account/Ship To/... and Date/Proposal Reference/... blocks) as a single aligned table instead of two independent side-by-side columns. The old layout let one side's wrapped multi-line values (a long address, an email) drift out of vertical sync with the other side, so unrelated labels and values visually ran into each other with no gap — confirmed from a screenshot. Now every row shares one height, there's a real gap between the two halves, and values are left-aligned so wrapped lines stay readable. Verified by rendering the exact data from the screenshot before publishing.
